name: 10000 Lakes Festival 2009
description: The 10,000 Lakes Festival (abbreviated as 10KLF) was an annual four-day music festival in Detroit Lakes, Minnesota, at the Soo Pass Ranch that was held from 2003 until 2009 before going on indefinite hiatus due to financial losses and has not been held since 2010.
lineup: The Scene @ 10000 Lakes Festival 2009

name: 18hrs Festival 2016

name: 515 Alive 2016

name: 80/35 Music Festival 2019
description: For over a decade, the non-profit 80/35 festival has been filling downtown Des Moines with live music. Taking advantage of road touring artists that pass through on Interstates 80 and 35, this two-day fest always has a solid lineup of indie rock and other genres to delight the fans. name: Balaton Sound 2011
description: 'Seaside lounges, restaurants, bars and anything you need to enjoy the Balaton sunset, plus a great number of stars on several stages, that’s the already beloved concept of Balaton Sound. The event attracts approx. 100 000 visitors each year and turns Zamárdi, a small town on the southern shores of Lake Balaton into a massive party arena. The festival’s venue is a picturesque beach resort at the biggest lake of Central Europe, also regarded as a touristic center of the region.'

name: Bestival 2012

name: Between the Trees 2026
description: Between The Trees is a nature and science-themed festival created in 2014 by educators Andrew Thomas and Dawn Wood to help re-engage people with the natural world. Responding to growing screen dependence, stress, and a loss of community connection, the festival brings together original indie-folk music, art, spoken word, and creativity-focused activities in an inclusive, supportive environment. Held in the Merthyr Mawr National Nature Reserve—one of Wales’ Sites of Special Scientific Interest, the event immerses attendees in magical woodlands, sweeping sand dunes, and coastal landscapes to inspire curiosity, well-being, and a renewed bond with nature.

name: Big Ears 2014

The venues are varied including the Knoxville Museum of Art, a cathedral, and an ornate theater.

name: Bristol Sounds 2026
description: Bristol Sounds transforms the city’s waterfront into a lively open-air concert series every summer. Over several nights in late June, the festival offers a mix of musical styles from indie rock and pop to electronic and throwback classics featuring headline acts alongside rising talent, giving something for a wide range of musical tastes. With its unique harbour-side setting, summer-evening vibe, and carefully curated lineups, Bristol Sounds blends the intimacy of a city gig with the energy of a classic festival.

name: Bumbershoot 2012
description: Now in its fourth decade, Bumbershoot (a oldie time word for umbrella) is more of an institution than a music festival. There’s so much happening here that you’ll need all three days to sort through all the live music, art shows, speakers, and exhibitions happening under the Bumbershoot. With a budget friendly price (and children under ten are FREE), this fest is one of the most affordable and family friendly of the season.

name: Bunbury Music Festival 2012

Taking a stake in advancing into the future, Bunbury also incorporates eco-friendly and technology initiatives.

name: Cambridge Rock Festival 2012
description: 'A superb Rock Festival featuring mainly Rock and Blues, with added Prog, NWBHM, great food and 70 real ales, ciders, wines and lager! Ben's Yard is adjacent to the site and offers a rural retail village on the beautifully landscaped Stuntney Estate. Boasting an all independent set of retailers, including a cafe, restaurant, butchers, a variety of shops covering fashion, homeware and lifestyle, as well as wildflower trails and a childrens adventure playground styled after Ely Cathedral! The Stuntney (Ely) venue offers great access via trains into Ely station, just 1.4 miles from the site as well as easy assess via the A14 and A10. This site is as always subject to licence, and is currently home to another long established folk festival.'

name: Deer Valley Music Festival 2023
venue: Deer Valley Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater
description: The Festival takes place over five weeks in Park City, Utah. Performances on Wednesday night feature the Utah Symphony performing chamber orchestra music in the intimate setting of St. Mary's Catholic Church. Thursday night performances feature guest chamber ensembles, also typically at St. Mary's. Friday and Saturday night performances are typically classical music performances often with guest artists featuring popular music at Deer Valley Resort Snow Park Outdoor Amphitheater. Intimate salon performances by guest artists and members of the Utah Symphony at area homes are also a staple of the festival.

The mix of music includes everything from mainstream rock to electronic to pop.

name: Electric Paradise 2026
description: The Electric Paradise is a contemporary electronic and dance music festival held in Buckinghamshire. It is known for its immersive production, featuring multiple stages with DJs and live electronic acts spanning house, techno, and experimental genres. The festival typically emphasizes a high-energy atmosphere with large-scale lighting, visual installations, and curated outdoor spaces designed for an all-night party experience. Alongside the music, attendees can expect food stalls, themed areas, and a strong focus on creating a vibrant summer festival environment in the English countryside.

name: Electric Picnic 2011
description: Ireland's mega-festival crams in so much music and activities into three short days, that you'll be hard-pressed to sample everything over the weekend. Besides having one of the best lineups of the year, there's endless fields of camping along with forested glades inhabited by late night revelers. From partying at a pirate ship to secret shows in the chapel to drinking in the Trailer Park, this is an unforgettable festival.

description: The Everglades Roots Festival is a grassroots winter gathering held each January at Trail Lakes Campground in Florida, bringing together bluegrass, Southern rock, folk, jam bands, and singer-songwriters for a laid-back celebration beneath the cypress trees. What began as a small pickin’ party has grown into a weekend of campfires, pickin’ circles, touring and local talent, camping, craft and food vendors, and immersive swamp-culture experiences unique to the Big Cypress. More than just a music event, it honors tradition, community, and the wild spirit of Old Florida.

At the end of town, festies gather over the scenic (and occasionally rainbow boasting) estuary of the River Dwyryd to dance their way into the night.

It’s part of the broader Fête du Bruit festival family alongside the better-known Landerneau edition and has become one of Brittany’s major summer music gatherings, attracting tens of thousands of fans for three days of live music and festival culture.

Hosted in the heart of the Ozark Mountains on the stunning DHP property known as The Farm, the region has a rich history with bluegrass music, and Hillberry honors this past while ushering in this continually unfolding story of music, mountains, and community. With attendance capped at 3000, attendees can expect a truly intimate festival and camping experience.'

description: Iceland Eclipse is a 4-day transformational gathering, which takes place during Iceland’s once-in-a-century total solar eclipse. name: INmusic Festival 2011
description: Perhaps the only music festival in the world that runs from Monday to Wednesday, Croatia's largest open-air fest straddles two national holidays. It may not be on the beach, but INmusic boasts a sweet lakeside venue with camping on Youth Island in Zagreb. The international lineup always features huge acts (some of them playing Croatia for the first time) like Florence+the Machine, Arctic Monkeys, Pixies, Arcade Fire, New Order, and Billy Idol.

name: Inside Seaside 2025
description: Inside Seaside is a two-day indoor music and culture festival held each autumn. Since its launch in 2023, Inside Seaside has rapidly grown into one of Poland’s largest and most vibrant indoor festivals. Across three stages, the festival showcases a mix of international and Polish musicians spanning rock, indie, electronic, jazz, pop, folk, and experimental music. Festival-goers can explore film screenings, art exhibitions, vinyl & poster fairs, a silent-disco, themed zones, and a food hall. The indoor format makes it a cozy but high-energy alternative to summer festivals.

name: Jerome Craft Beer Experience 2023
description: The Jerome Craft Beer Experience celebrates Arizona's finest craft beers in the rustic mountainside ghost town of Jerome AZ. Guests of this unique event will get the chance to sample craft beers from some of the best breweries, cideries and distilleries in Arizona. name: Joshua Tree Festival Spring 2014
description: The DIY Joshua Tree Music Festival puts out two editions of desert loving fun during the shoulder seasons of spring and autumn. Just a few hours from the hectic vibes of Los Angeles, Joshua Tree is a haven of magical surroundings with phenomenal live music. name: Joshua Tree Festival Fall 2014
description: Joshua Tree is 4 days of music, yoga, workshops, art, a silent disco and more. Music rotates between three stages from 10am - 2am creating a continuous sonic journey each day. The music is a diverse medley of genres and styles curated to seamlessly blend and build as the day progresses. During breaks from the dance floor fans can enjoy yoga and workshops, indulge in a massage at the Healing Oasis, or take a stroll around the lake and the grounds to take in the art and the raw beauty of the desert landscape.

name: Joshua Tree Festival Fall 2021
description: 'These independently produced music festivals are held annually in the shadows of the infamous National Park. They are two (of the very few) multi-day campout music festivals in Southern California featuring live music. Music lovers of all ages enjoy this phenomenal live music in an intimate setting and magical surroundings. The spring festival features an eclectic line up of performers; dance-world-electro-funk'n groove. The fall fest differs musically with artists of the more rootsicana-newgrassy-folkadelic realms. The two different musical stylings create distinct audiences at the festivals, but many folks do attend both. The town of Joshua Tree is located in the high desert of the magical Mojave, 50 minutes from Palm Springs, 2.5 hour drive from LA, 3 from San Diego, 3.5 from Vegas, and 5 from Phoenix, at the entrance to the world renowned national park.'

name: Kazantip 2012
description: Kazantip was a unique electronic dance music festival and beach party that took place on the Crimean Peninsula in Ukraine. It was known for its distinctive and immersive experience, combining music, art, and an unconventional party atmosphere. The festival's name is derived from the Kazantip cape, a location on the Black Sea where the event was held. Kazantip was not just a music festival; it was also a temporary republic with its own rules and customs.

name: LeeStock Music Festival 2026
description: LeeStock Music Festival is an annual, family-friendly weekend of live music, food and community held in memory of Lee Dunford. The event doubles as a charity fundraiser, with proceeds supporting the Willow Foundation, a UK charity. Fans will enjoy a mix of indie, rock, pop and acoustic acts, local and national talent, plus festival amenities like camping, dedicated family zones, food vendors, and local beer & cider offerings. Over the years, it’s grown from a grassroots memorial gathering into one of Suffolk’s beloved smaller-scale festivals—where music, charity, and community spirit come together.

name: Lollapalooza Chicago 2011
description: It’s loud. It’s messy. It’s Lollapalooza. name: Lovefest 2019
description: 'The extremely budget-friendly Lovefest is a solid addition to the quickly growing Balkan electronic music festival circuit. In the United States and England, we have all these archaic laws about noise past midnight, but Serbia has no such qualms, and the music stays bumping literally into the dawn. The gates don’t open until sunset, and it’s empty until around midnight, at which point you can barely move until sunrise.' - 100nightsofsummer.com

The festival calls itself “a true backpacker’s Garden Of Eden and Holland’s most adventurous cultural outdoorevent, offering a cutting edge choice of only the best in alternative music, film, stand-up comedy, visual arts, literature and street theatre.”

name: Mariposa Folk Festival 2023
description: Canada’s most iconic music event, The Mariposa Folk Festival was first held in Orillia in 1961. It later moved to Toronto and other sites in Ontario until returning home in 2000 to Orillia. The 3-day Festival is a family-friendly celebration of song, story, dance and craft in the bucolic setting of Tudhope Park. More than 50 artists appear on stages throughout the park including a pub stage and outstanding evening main stage performances. Special areas for children’s activities, artisans, and food vendors make Mariposa a magical experience for people of all ages.

name: MerleFest 2011
description: Thirty years ago, the legendary Doc Watson founded MerleFest to honor the memory of his son who died in a tragic accident. Now 80,000 fans gather every spring on the campus of Wilkes Community College for America's largest roots festival. Legends mix with newcomers to perform surprising collaborations of bluegrass, folk, and Americana.

name: Music At The Intersection 2024
description: From the West African coasts to the Caribbean islands, up through the Mississippi Delta, music flows like a river. A beating vein that feeds the soul. Born of struggle and grit, joy and liberation, a resilient American rhythm – the hum of our river city and its sisters. This fall in St. Louis, we celebrate the great spirits of blues, jazz, soul, R&B, hip-hop, and rock n' roll. Over three days in the streets and greenscapes of Grand Center, we honor the giants who shaped our sound and call up a new wave.

name: Northern Nights 2014
description: Connecting music and nature, Northern Nights Music Festival is one of the most sought after events held at Cook’s Valley Campground in Northern California. Promoted as a music and arts, camping, yoga and cannabis retreat, the festival features a varied lineup of primarily electronic artists. Still a small festival by industry standards, Northern Nights tops out at 6,000 attendees. The selective attendee limit and festival grounds play a large role in Northern Nights success. The campgrounds are home to swimming holes and the largest Redwood grove in the nation where camping is allowed.

name: Oktoberfest Frankfurt 2026
description: Over a span of slightly less than four weeks, this German celebration draws in a crowd of 60,000 attendees. The Frankfurt Oktoberfest encapsulates the genuine essence of the Munich beer festival, featuring traditional games, enchanting music, and of course, an abundance of finely brewed beer.

name: Oktoberfest Hannover 2025
description: Indulge in a two-week extravaganza of festivities at the Oktoberfest celebration in Hannover, Germany, The 3rd largest Oktoberfest in the world offers more than just the quintessential German culinary delights and beverages; it presents a kaleidoscope of experiences including exhilarating carnival rides, mesmerizing firework displays, spirited dance competitions, and an array of engaging activities.

name: Oktoberfest Leipzig 2026
description: The renowned Oktoberfest Leipzig is nothing short of legendary. Annually, nearly 40,000 attendees come together at the historic Old Leipzig Trade Fair grounds to partake in traditional festivities. Spanning a vibrant four-week duration, the event pulsates with a medley of party anthems, a flowing river of beer, and a delectable array of Oktoberfest culinary delights.

name: Oktoberfest Mannheim 2026
description: Over the span of four weekends in October and November, the spirit of Oktoberfest comes alive in Mannheim, captivating festival enthusiasts. This cherished event, thriving since its inception in 2009, beckons. While predominantly an adult affair, attendees will immerse themselves in the embrace of time-honored German gastronomy and beverages, complemented by the cadence of live music and the joyous rhythms of dance.

name: Oktoberfest Munich 2026
description: Oktoberfest is a legendary German festival that takes place in Munich every year in late September and early October. It is a celebration of Bavarian culture and features beer, food, music, and carnival rides. Millions of people from around the world attend to experience the unique atmosphere and celebrate Bavarian traditions.

name: Open Buzludzha 2025
description: For the fifth consecutive year, the Buzludzha Project Foundation invites all lovers of unforgettable experiences, beautiful nature, and meaningful causes to a unique three-day event in the heart of the Balkan Mountains.The festival brings people together in support of preserving and opening the Buzludzha Monument as a space for art, culture, and history. The cause is non-political and does not aim for full restoration, but rather for conservation and adaptive reuse for educational and touristic purposes.

name: Oslo World 2025
description: Oslo World is an annual world-music festival in Norway’s capital, taking place across venues ranging from clubs to concert halls. Founded in 1994, it highlights music from Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East, blending traditional and contemporary styles. Beyond performances, the festival also hosts talks, seminars, and cultural events, often framed around social and political themes, making it both a celebration of global music and a platform for dialogue and cultural exchange.

name: Outskirts Music Festival 2026
description: Outskirts Music Festival is a one-day outdoor music event on the SaskTel Centre festival grounds in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. The festival aims to transform the venue’s parking lot into a vibrant prairie-sky concert experience combining rock, country, and alt-leaning acts. Beyond the music, the event will include food vendors, cold drinks, and festival vibes designed to bring big-stage energy to the city and gather music lovers for a memorable summer kickoff.

name: Outwards Festival 2026
description: Outwards is an electronic music festival and a 5,000-capacity day-to-night event. Rather than a traditional headline-driven festival, it's conceived as a cultural meeting point that connects originators, underground innovators, and emerging voices in a single intergenerational dialogue, with a lineup spanning classic artists alongside Manchester legends.  Beyond the music, the event also features artist talks, independent record fairs, a hi-fi listening bar, and after-parties extending across the city into the night.

name: Pistoia Blues Festival 2026
description: Pistoia Blues Festival is one of Italy’s most historic and celebrated music events, held every summer since 1980 in the Tuscan city of Pistoia. It began as the first Italian festival dedicated to blues and over the decades has grown into a major international showcase for blues, rock, soul and related genres, bringing legendary artists and rising talents to the open-air stage. The medieval city center is transformed during the festival into a lively cultural hub known for its rich musical legacy and intimate atmosphere. The festival draws music lovers from around the world each July for a mix of headliner performances, free city-wide events, and vibrant local energy.

name: Poole Harbour Festival 2026
description: The Poole Harbour Festival is a three-day summer celebration in Baiter Park, Poole, blending live music, family fun, and coastal charm. With over 60 acts across multiple stages (including the pirate-themed Smuggler’s Inn), the festival combines headline performances with a strong community spirit. Visitors can enjoy kids’ activities, circus workshops, walkabout performers, artisan markets, and a wide range of street food, local ales, and crafts. Set against the scenic backdrop of Poole Harbour, the event has become one of Dorset’s favorite summer gatherings—welcoming families, music lovers, and festival-goers of all ages.

name: Pop Montreal 2011
description: Wonderfully weird and beautifully under-appreciated, Pop Montreal is your best excuse to visit the city in the fall. Venues are scattered across the city from the largest clubs to unique venues (parks and cathedrals) to a single dude singing in the back of a vintage clothing store. And when you need a break from the crowds and music, it’s easy to slip into one of Montreal’s amazing restaurants or bars.

Along with the main festival, the nights are filled with club events and there’s even a free Saturday family concert.

name: Pukkelpop 2011
description: The alternative flavored Pukkelpop is the second largest festival in Belgium boasting crowds of nearly 180,000. Started in 1985 as a simple single day show, Pukkelpop now features hundreds of bands over three days. The fest has changed venues a few times, but currently resides in the tiny village of Hasselt, which is located 45 miles from Brussels. Pukkelpop alumni include Pixies, Björk, The Stone Roses, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Radiohead, Metallica, and The Prodigy. And of course, tradiation Belgian beers can be found everywhere.

Started in 1985 as a simple single day show, Pukkelpop now features hundreds of bands over three days. The fest has changed venues a few times, but currently resides in the tiny village of Hasselt, which is located 45 miles from Brussels. Pukkelpop alumni include Pixies, Björk, The Stone Roses, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Radiohead, Metallica, and The Prodigy. And of course, tradiation Belgian beers can be found everywhere.

name: Quebec City Summer Festival 2014
description: For those of you seeking a music festival and a taste of old world charm, check out the mammoth Quebec City Summer Festival. Stretching for an astounding eleven days, historic Quebec City is overrun by an astounding 1.5 million fans. There’s plenty of other activities happening in Canada’s French-iest city. As they say on their website: “During the Festival, the whole city is celebrating!”

name: Rampage Open Air 2023
description: Rampage Open Air boasts 300+ artists across 6 areas, plus an unforgettable Thursday camping party. Adrenaline seekers will love the 5 giant fair rides and the biggest skate ramp in Europe. Chill with friends at the market place, where you'll find body & face painting, jewelry, and more. Foodies, get ready to indulge in classic festival fare and a variety of food truck options from sweet to savory, including vegan and veggie options. Stay on-site with camping for 10,000 people, complete with 3 swimming pools and 2 camping stages featuring national and international artists. Keep the party going with the fully covered free silent disco after-party for campers, with a separate bar and a capacity of 2,000. Take a break with a movie at the open-air cinema, or enjoy fresh barbecue, breakfast, and shopping at the camping area.

Lucky for us festies, the cozy ski town of Telluride lets us take a summertime sample at The Ride Festival. 'Since its debut in 2012, The RIDE Festival has quickly garnered a reputation among music fans for its thoughtful performance curation – handpicking rootsy, rocking talent whose music flawlessly compliments the festival’s stunning Telluride, Colorado setting.'

name: Rifflandia 2014

With a die-hard following of loyal, music-loving fans, Rifflandia Festival has forever shaped what September means in Victoria as THE “can’t miss” party of the year. name: Riot Fest Chicago 2011
description: For fans of punk, alt rock, and artists you won’t see on other festival lineups, Riot Fest should be on your bucket list. Started as a showcase festival in Chicago in 2005, Riot Fest has transformed into a multi-day outdoor festival and has spawned editions in Toronto and Denver. The original in Chicago remains the best and most solid lineup of the bunch.

name: Rise and Vibes Music Festival 2023
description: Rise and Vibes Music Festival is an annual music and camping festival that unfolds within the natural beauty of the Animas River Valley. Located between Aztec, NM and Durango, CO, this carefully curated music festival is in the heart of one of the most breathtaking parts of Colorado and New Mexico. The festival offers full hookup RV sites, car camping, shaded river-side tent camping, permanent bathroom and shower facilities, food and craft vendors, a beach, general store and so much more.

name: Roadburn Festival 2015
description: It's not common to run across a boutique heavy music festival, but then again, nothing about the two decade old Roadburn Festival is run-of-the-mill. Held in the Dutch city of Tilburg, Roadburn's genre boundary pushing lineup ask festies to redefine their definition of heavy. Taking place in the early spring, 4000 attendees a day come to bang heads, with three quarters of the crowd from outside the Netherlands.

description: There’s festivals. There’s mega-festivals. And then there’s Roskilde. Taking place over a staggering eight days and two weekends, the unstoppable juggurnaut has hosted upwards of 135,000 fans, more than 150 bands, and even boasts 32,000 volunteers. Roskilde proudly remains a non-profit donating millions Danish krona every year to various charities. Oh, and they also have a naked run so have fun in Denmark!

Known for its inclusive atmosphere and no-frills approach, the festival showcases a mix of established punk acts and emerging bands across classic punk, street punk, and hardcore styles, all set against the seaside town’s working-class backdrop. It emphasizes affordability, independence, and keeping punk accessible while bringing together fans, bands, and labels for a loud, passionate weekend of music and camaraderie.

name: Slam Dunk Festival 2020
description: Slam Dunk started out as a pop-punk club night at The Cockpit, Leeds in the early 00's. Out of the success of the club night Slam Dunk started putting on international touring artists from the genre like Fallout Boy, Paramore and Panic! at The Disco in Leeds, before developing Slam Dunk Festival.  Slam Dunk Festival is now the number one pop-punk, rock and alternative festival in the UK held over 2 fully outdoor sites in Hatfield Park and Temple Newsam Park in Leeds to over 50,000 rock fans.

name: Slam Dunk Germany 2026
description: Slam Dunk Festival Germany is the German edition of the long-running Slam Dunk Festival, a rock and alternative music event rooted in the UK punk and hardcore scene. Part of the wider Slam Dunk Europe series, the 1-day event showcases both influential bands and rising talent from the alternative scene. With roots dating back to 2006 in the UK, Slam Dunk has grown into one of the largest independent rock festivals in Europe, known for its high-energy crowds and genre-spanning lineup of punk, rock, and hardcore artists.

name: Slam Dunk Italy 2026
description: Slam Dunk Italy is the Italian edition of the long-running Slam Dunk Festival, a touring rock festival rooted in the UK’s punk, pop-punk, hardcore, and alternative music scene. As part of the Slam Dunk Europe tour, the festival showcases bands spanning pop-punk, metalcore, and post-hardcore, continuing the brand’s reputation as one of Europe’s most important gatherings for modern alternative music fans.

description: From the country that invented apres-ski parties comes Snowattack, an annual mid-winter ode to electronic music and ski culture. The week long festival takes place at the Les Orres ski area in France with over 100 kilometers of slopes and 19 lifts to keep you entertained between a packed lineup of DJs.
